name: TALAKA_MEMORY_PROMOTE_INTERVAL
effect: Seconds between full promote.sh runs triggered by memory writes. A high-confidence entry still reaches L3 at once (promote.sh --single-shot); only the L4 index waits. 0 runs a full promote on every write (slow on Git Bash).

name: TALAKA_METRICS_MAX_RUN
effect: Longest plausible worker run. A --since older than this, or a --wall-ms above it, is recorded as null rather than as a measurement.

name: TALAKA_COST_PER_TOKEN
effect: Flat rate for rows passed --tokens without a measurement. Unset on purpose: an invented rate makes an unmeasured row look priced. Measured rows are priced from pricing.json.

name: TALAKA_COST_PER_MIN
effect: Wall-clock price added to cost_usd. The API bills tokens, not time — set it only if your team prices agent minutes.

name: TALAKA_WIKI_DIR
effect: Where the committed knowledge wiki lives, relative to the project root.

name: TALAKA_ISSUES_REPO
effect: Repository field reports are filed on — point it at your fork.

name: TALAKA_PROMPT_TIMEOUT
effect: How long init.sh waits for an answer at its interactive prompts.

name: PACE_SNAPSHOT_REFRESH
effect: The statusline rewrites .tlk/usage.env only when the numbers change, or after this many seconds to keep captured_at fresh.

name: ARTEFACTS_DIR
effect: Relocates the whole artefacts tree.

name: Test command
effect: Full regression suite. Bagnik's gates always run it.

name: Focused test command
effect: Runs a subset; Cmok appends a path or pattern for the tests covering what it changed.

name: Build command
effect: Run on every build and before every code QA. Unset: the Build line says so.

name: Version files
effect: Files whose X.Y.Z is bumped: patch by Cmok, minor by Zlydni.

name: Artifacts directory
effect: Where agents look for the artefacts tree. Keep in step with ARTEFACTS_DIR.

name: Design system directory
effect: Where the extracted design system lives.

name: Judge command
effect: CLI for the LLM-as-judge.

name: Judge samples
effect: Times the judge is asked per verdict. Strict: 1 only if every sample says 1.

name: Generator command
effect: CLI the ratchet runs each variant with. Plain-text output leaves the cost term unmeasured.

name: Side-task promotion
effect: A side-task touching more files or top-level areas, or leaving more open known gaps, is promoted to a feature.

name: Pace thresholds
default: slow5h=-15 slow7d=-10 push5h=20 push7d=10 stop5h=90 stop7d=95
effect: Surplus (points) at which a usage window means slow-down or speed-up, and used % at which it means stop.

name: λ (cost weight)
effect: composite = accuracy − λ·cost. Higher λ makes Veles prefer cheaper prompts over more accurate ones.

name: decay-variants.sh --days
effect: Rejected variants older than this are pruned.

name: Feature STUCK alert
effect: A feature whose handoff-log has not changed for this long shows STUCK.

name: mem:stale alert
effect: SESSION-STATE.md untouched for this long shows mem:stale.

name: Usage-limit alert
effect: A usage window at or above 80% is named on line 2 (yellow); at 95% in red.

name: SESSION in-flight clear
effect: In-flight decisions in SESSION-STATE.md are emptied once it is older than this.

name: L2 compaction age
effect: Daily memory files older than this are compacted into a weekly stub.

name: Ratchet stop after rejects
effect: Three consecutive rejected rounds end the run.

name: Kit-issue evidence kept
effect: --evidence-file keeps a log's last 60 lines, an idea's first 200, and says how many were left out.

name: Kit-issue duplicate match
effect: Titles sharing 3 key words, or 2 that make up half the shorter title, are flagged as likely duplicates.

name: Dashboard refresh
effect: The open page re-reads the snapshot every 30 s; Live mode reads the folder every 5 s.

name: Fix-loop breaking
default: no limit; stop after 3 identical fails
effect: Bagnik ⇄ Cmok fix loops have no iteration limit; the same check failing twice surfaces Yaga, three cycles with no change stop and report.
